Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps (demo & security/procurement)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the great discovery session this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps:

- Key objectives you mentioned: reduce inference latency for real-time recommendations, get costs predictable across dev/prod, and satisfy auditability for PII-sensitive flows.
- Roadmap fit: Looks like a demo + technical deep-dive is the right next move so we can run through latency profiles, routing/fallback options, and our security/compliance controls.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 60-minute demo + 30-minute technical deep-dive (can be split across two sessions)
2) Loop in your security and procurement contacts so we can surface SOC2, data retention, and contract path
3) Share discovery notes and a proposed demo agenda (attached).

My availability this week (Pacific):
- Thu 4/17: 10:00–11:30, 14:00–16:00
- Fri 4/18: 09:00–12:00

If you can share a couple slots that work for Priya (security) and Tom (procurement), I’ll lock it in. I’m cc’ing Vivek (Solutions Engineer) to coordinate the technical session.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
